description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to latest LTS versions

tasks.description: Upgrade to Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.4 with Jakarta EE migration
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to 21, Spring Boot to 3.4, Spring Framework to 6.x, and migrate javax.* to jakarta.* namespaces where applicable
tasks.summary: Successfully upgraded from Java 1.6 to Java 21 and introduced Spring Boot 3.4.5 (Spring Framework 6.2.6 / Jakarta EE 10). Updated pom.xml with Spring Boot 3.4.5 parent and Java 21 source/target, migrated all javax.* dependencies to Jakarta EE 10 equivalents, added SpringBootApplication main class, updated 5 Servlet classes to jakarta.servlet.*, updated web.xml to Servlet 6.0 Jakarta EE schema, updated JSTL URIs in JSPs, and updated Dockerfile to use maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21 and tomcat:10.1-jre21. Build and tests pass.
